verdict.rationale: Brave Search API covers all three steps under one API family. It has web search, an LLM Context endpoint returning pre-extracted, token-budgeted page content with no scraping needed (docs-39, docs-55), and an Answers endpoint that synthesizes answers grounded on single or multiple searches with verifiable sources, plus a summarizer (docs-17, docs-27, docs-16). These are also exposed to agents through the official MCP server (docs-15). AI-agent use requires the separate AI Inference plan rather than the free tier (comm-1, comm-2). Missing for 10: a documented endpoint to extract contents from arbitrary user-supplied URLs (extraction is tied to search results), explicit documentation of an orchestrated multi-step research mode, and independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
